svg.text: The best energies at each cost, instance by instance
Every energy whose paper, or QMBL's own run, states what it cost in hours, on the 9 instances with at least two such rows.
The line is the frontier: the results nothing beats for less. Colour is the kind of number; filled marks can hold a record, hollow
Circles are GPU-hours, squares CPU core-hours (8 rows). A whisker under a mark means the hours are devices × wall-clock, multiplied here (12
rows). The horizontal line is the instance's record, costed or not.
